messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — Elevated 5xx rate detected for Aquilo on dedicated-gpu-3 (eu-west-1). Route: customer-dedicated/eu-west-1. Paging oncall group: @deepak (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx || Incident ID: INC-2026-4102345678
sarah (ops): Acked. I'm taking lead for mitigation. Collecting traces and routing table now.
deepak (oncall): On it. Attaching current top-line traces. Seeing rapid OOM-driven retries on worker-7. Spinning a replacement node and forcing fallback to model-variant: redwood-v1-small.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback started: removing worker-7 from pool -> replacement instance requested (req-2391).
sarah (ops): Good. Jordan — can you confirm primary Aquilo contacts and preferred comm channel? Need to draft customer-facing statement ASAP. @jordan (AM)
jordan (AM): Primary contacts: ops@aquilo.com (S. Patel), eng-oncall@aquilo.com (pager), account exec: jordan.p@redwood.com. Preferred channel: email + status page; send to ops@ first, then exec.
emma (CS): I'll prepare the tailored impact blurb. Suggest we avoid speculative root cause in customer text. Keep to impact + mitigation + ETA.
sarah (ops): Agreed. Drafting status page + email below — please quick review and sign-off.
--- status page draft ---
```
Summary: We are experiencing increased 5xx errors for Aquilo's dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 resulting in intermittent request failures for affected routes.
Impact: Some API requests (text generation and embeddings) may fail with 5xx or experience elevated latency. Not all requests are affected.
Scope: Aquilo (dedicated-gpu-3). We are continuing to route traffic to fallback model variants to reduce failures.
Mitigation: On-call has removed the impacted worker and initiated replacement nodes. Automatic fallback to a compatible model variant is enabled.
ETA: Initial mitigation in progress; service level expected to improve within 15-30 minutes. We will post another update in 30 minutes or when status changes.
```
--- end draft ---
sarah (ops): Email template for ops@aquilo.com below — short and specific.
--- customer email draft ---
```
Subject: Immediate update: Service disruption affecting Aquilo dedicated cluster (eu-west-1)

Hi S. Patel / Aquilo ops team,

We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting your dedicated cluster (dedicated-gpu-3, eu-west-1). Some API requests may fail or have higher latency. Our on-call team has removed the affected worker and enabled automatic fallback to a compatible model variant to reduce impact.

What we're doing: replacing the faulty worker, enabling fallbacks, and monitoring traffic.
What you can expect: service improvement within 15-30 minutes. We will follow up with a post-incident summary once we have confirmed stability.

If you need immediate assistance or have active customer sessions to protect, please reply or call your on-call: +1-555-0102.

Apologies for the disruption — we know how critical this is.

Thanks,
Jordan (Redwood Account Team)
```
--- end draft ---
deepak (oncall): Approved. I'll attach a short internal note about paging escalation and handoff for the postmortem.
sarah (ops): Quick routing note for ops: Primary pager -> eng-oncall@aquilo.com, secondary -> ops@aquilo.com, AM -> jordan.p@redwood.com. Escalation timeline: 0–15m -> oncall, 15–45m -> senior infra, 45m+ -> exec notification.
jordan (AM): Thanks. Emma — can you hold the customer notification and send once we see latency drop? If degradation continues beyond 30m, send now.
emma (CS): Understood. I'll queue email and hold until confirmation or 30m.
sarah (ops): Mitigation status: replacement node provisioned (req-2391 succeeded), traffic rebalanced, and 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 4% over last 7 minutes.
deepak (oncall): Confirming fallback rates high but successful. Preparing handoff to night oncall in 40 minutes. I'll add notes to INC-2026-4102345678 runbook entry.
sarah (ops): Noted. Last call for additional customer-specific routing changes?
jordan (AM): None. Keep me updated.
sarah (ops): Will update status page and close thread when stable. :white_check_mark:
